== What changed on the image ==
[[File:ANH-L-ra7-PC-Errata-2013-slip-changes.png|none|900px|Before and after]]
Compared with the printed card [[RA-7 (Aray-Seven)]] (Decipher; Decipher's [[RA-7 (Aray-Seven) (Decipher Errata 1998)|November 1998 errata]] was published as text only): The game text changes: “Your” becomes “May transfer character weapons (for free) to or from your other”; “with weapons may give them to this droid during your deploy phase, for free. RA-7 can” becomes “present. May”; “(but not use)” is dropped; “such” is added after “up to four”; “and redeploy to warriors present for free.” becomes “at one time.”. These are the same words as [[RA-7 (Aray-Seven) (Decipher Errata 1998)|Decipher's errata]]. The slip adds a black strip below the text box with the title “•RA-7 (Aray-Seven)” and no “E”.

Lower part of the printed card (the area the slip covers, scaled to the slip's width) and the slip as cut from the sheet at 300 dpi; nothing else is edited.
